'''Crescent Canyon''' was a massive canyon located in the northern [[Clabburn Tundra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], separating the [[Whiterock Wastes]] and [[Highmount Ridge]]. Formed by shifting sections of ice, the loop-shaped canyon encircled the [[Crescent Canyon Mesa]] and was a highly contested location during the [[Battle of Hoth (Galactic War)|battle]] for Hoth during the [[Galactic War]].
